reviews.author: Shenteirio Manning
reviews.text: I’ve purchased several cars from Virginia Automotive Service, and every one of them has been reliable and long-lasting. The vehicles were well maintained and truly worth the investment. Ed was always honest, straightforward, and easy to work with, which made the entire process stress-free. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for a dependable car and trustworthy service.

reviews.author: Erin Cloud
reviews.text: Cannot recommend VA Automotive Service more! I broke down near their shop on a Thursday and they walked me through it & allowed me to leave it overnight for them to access on Friday and I had it back in working order on Monday. They are honest and upfront and did excellent work. I appreciate them so much!

reviews.author: Dan
reviews.text: Best prices in town! Fast and great quality service. You can really depend on these guys, especially when you’re In a crunch or a bind.

reviews.author: Hunter Alford
reviews.text: Have been using this shop over the last 15 years for all of my oil changes and services on all my vehicles including my Kia which has over 290K miles on it now. Recently took my 2021 Chevy in for new tires. Good price and quick service. Ted has been fantastic and taken great care of my vehicles over the years. I highly recommend this shop!
